## Summary

Describe the problem and the focused change.

## Security boundary

State the affected parsing context and whether escaping rules, package exports,

## Verification

- [ ] Tests cover the behavior change or documentation-only scope is explained.
- [ ] `npm run check` passes.
- [ ] No runtime dependency was added without explicit justification.
- [ ] No private vulnerability or sensitive data is disclosed.
- [ ] Documentation and changelog entries are updated where required.
